title: Smart Capture Saves Time
description: The Smart Capture allows you to upload a receipt and it will automatically extract the data and link it to your bank transactions.
author: Barry Adams
html:
Smart Capture is one of the best features of FreeAgent. It allows you to simply take a photo of a receipt or invoice, upload it into the App, and it will automatically extract the data from the receipt and link it to your bank account transactions.

This means you can do your accounts on the go, and you will never search for a missing receipt again.

Get into the habit of doing this as soon as you spend any money, and you will save time and money when it comes to doing your final accounts at the end of the year.

It does require some set-up, and if you want to upload more than 10 receipts per month you will need to purchase an add-on from FreeAgent, but it is very easy to do. If you need any help with this, we are of course always happy to assist you with this.
